about: Grammar audit test cases (Phase 4). Each case names the rule it tests by its source (a ruling id or a section of the lexicon's grammar), an expected Liraasa sentence derived only from the spec (`good`, with `alts` that the spec equally allows), the English it translates (`en`, run through the editor's Compose tab), and optionally a sentence that breaks the rule (`bad`), which the checker should flag, ideally citing `expect`. `english_check` runs the checker with the English beside the line. Run: npx tsx tests/audit/run.ts

cases.note: aspect (slot 11) before modal (slot 7) "I could sing" is ambiguous in English (past ability or conditional)
a command has no subject no ruling requires the comma
two modals
two evidentials (2.1:G51: one per clause)

cases.bad: Li dorbi ke lallesan hoyo yasmo!
Maivo po ne povi hiro telvo reve yehu lirala.
cases.note: six preverbal operators: the spec only recommends four, so a note is the expected strength
ne follows the tense (0.8:G2)
frame word without its comma: a warning

cases.good: Li bumre hozi, Kipo po bumreba ito.
cases.bad: Li bumre hozi, li lira hozi, Kipo po bumreba ito.
cases.note: two topics in one clause
nosi (might, 1.0:G3) and clause-final poye (1.0:G22) both render "maybe"
a scope operator with nothing to scope over

cases.bad: Maivo po lesvu saivo po pagopa.
cases.note: tense belongs to the main clause only English "let" does not mark tense
adjective after the noun (album reading AR-02)
quantifier after the article ke and ka both fit an adjective: a passing or a lasting state (the spec does not choose)
number after the noun
an l-initial verb takes l + a (lirala), not -sia. (nullona, the obvious wrong verb of nullo, is itself the negative noun "daylight": the reason n-initial verbs take -nia.)
opi is the irregular
mellinasan (small; little) is equally valid
one form or one derivation, not both
an unlisted derivation is a word (2.0:G41)
an unused slot

cases.good: Sige maivo po venreva, saivo ke benasan.
cases.bad: Sige maivo venreva, saivo ke benasan.
cases.note: a sige clause never inherits tense: it must be marked
0.8:R8's own example is an unused form since 2.0, when amorlira became an attested image compound (S03): it reads as an unused slot (K11)
eli + nela (this person) is an ordinary noun phrase
ne directly before nuna-
an answer: tense + verb
repeated predicate omitted after a contrasting subject

cases.good: Taivo desida ki, fime maivo senosia.
cases.note: ki before an appended quotation

cases.good: Maivo po sabesia fime saivo tefa pagopa.
cases.note: tefa in an inheriting clause: prior action

cases.good: Sidu lisrola ka livna de taivo.
Fime taivo po relnura ka baba juba.

cases.en: This bread is the same as father's bread.
cases.good: Eli bumre ka sambasan ko pilo de bumre.
alts: Eli bumre ke sambasan ko pilo de bumre.

cases.good: Saivo ke gase vanisan gase taivo.

cases.en: I ask whether you will return.
cases.good: Maivo masuma ki-oro taivo futu relnura.
cases.bad: Maivo masuma si taivo futu relnura.
cases.english_check: I ask whether you will return.

cases.note: must (logically) = tosu + seye
a note: the context of noma may be in an earlier line (canon: Maivori noma pilopa yasmo.)

cases.good: Taivo guraga maivo pendi dossa cono.
alts: Taivo guraga maivo pendi dossa conori.

cases.good: Maivo po vimova gase centa veluri.
Maivo desida oro miru oro nami.
Maivo lirala doli si taivo lirala.

alts: Nevi saivo ke silisan saivo lirala.

cases.bad: Vinto li bumre hozi, Kipo po bumreba ito.

cases.bad: Li nela raho lirala ka benasan.

cases.good: Li dapadonu po venreva kroti li foji.

cases.en: Do you want water or food?

cases.good: Maivo donuda li bumre ala li linu.
cases.bad: Maivo donuda li linu li bumre.

cases.en: The bread of the city is different from this bread.
cases.good: Li bumre de li cilni ka sambanasan da eli bumre.
alts: Li bumre de li cilni ke sambanasan da eli bumre.
cases.note: ke and ka both fit an adjective: a passing or a lasting state (the spec does not choose)

cases.en: The stars wrote songs about love.
cases.good: Li veluri po sarbisia lirari de amor.
cases.bad: Li veluri po sarbisia su amor.
cases.english_check: The stars wrote songs about love.
cases.note: su directly after a saying verb; the album writes VERB OBJECT su NP, which 2.2:G68 makes usage

cases.good: Taivo viki pagopa ligo maivo ki, maivo de amor?

cases.en: I open the door with the key.
cases.good: Maivo lallela li dorbi yuta li kemye.
cases.bad: Maivo lallela li dorbi ko li kemye.
cases.note: ko + a tool is "alongside" or, as here, a misused instrument: a note offering yuta

cases.en: The singer healed him with music.
cases.good: Li lirayo po yugemeyiya saivo yuta melo.
cases.bad: Li lirayo po yugemeyiya saivo ko melo.
cases.note: an abstract noun with ko may be the manner (2.3:G73): a note offering yuta is the expected strength ko melo is also grammar: the spirit of the act (2.3:G73)
alts: Li lirayo po yugemeyiya saivo ko melo.

cases.en: How many times did you sing?

cases.good: Li nimu raho maivo po lirala en ito, ka vanisan.
